reason: This PR adds a new DDL feature that crosses parser SQL semantics, executor behavior, and storage-region handling. The metadata shows grammar/AST changes in `pkg/parser/*`, executor logic in `pkg/executor/split.go`, and DDL/index job-path changes tied to real TiKV tests. That combination is central enough and risky enough to justify a deeper review for High issues such as incorrect SQL parsing/AST wiring, wrong execution-time split behavior, or unsafe region/index creation interactions.
